Car showrooms

AutoDMS

Stock, deposits, contracts and buyers — managed in one place.

A dealer management system for Algerian car showrooms: follow every vehicle from purchase to sale, record arboun deposits, print bilingual contracts and send quotes to buyers on WhatsApp.

Request a demoDescribe your project

The problem

Showrooms juggle notebooks, Excel files and phone galleries to keep track of their stock. Deposits are written on paper, margins are worked out by hand, and answering a buyer on WhatsApp means hunting for photos and prices.

What we built

AutoDMS gives the owner and the sales team one place to work. Every vehicle has its file — chassis number, customs and registration papers, purchase cost, photos and status. Selling, reserving or printing a document takes a few clicks, and the owner can check stock value and margins at any time.

Key modules

  • 01

    Stock & vehicle files

    VIN, papers, photos, purchase cost and status for every vehicle.

  • 02

    Deposits (arboun)

    Record a deposit, print the contract and follow the remaining balance.

  • 03

    Sales & margins

    Sale price, costs and margin per vehicle, per month and per seller.

  • 04

    Documents

    Contracts, invoices and window sheets in French and Arabic.

  • 05

    WhatsApp quotes

    Send a vehicle's specs, photos and price to a buyer in one click.

  • 06

    Roles & access

    Owner, sales and accounting each see what they need.

Platforms
Windows desktop (works offline) · Web dashboard · Android
Languages
French · Arabic
